integrity: Self-contained proof, ten exact witnesses, two different finite nonmembership certificates, and an executable standard-library verifier; no claims of independent audit or third-party confirmation.
scientific_limitations: The known closed-form Lucas ambiguity characterization is an external premise. The exact conductor concerns six summands allowing repetition, rather than up to six. Some related broader-method source texts were inaccessible or only partly inspected; publication priority is not established. title: The sharp sixfold additive conductor of doubly represented Lucas numbers
